name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold properties in the state of Nevada. The company acquires royalties on smaller producing, pre-production, and pre-resource properties, aggregating them into packages, and holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement on the Lapon Canyon Project. Founded in 2014 and formerly known as Tech Foundry Ventures, it is headquartered in Reno, Nevada.
